kpiScorecard.degradedTooltip: This composite KPI scored using its working inputs, but one or more child KPIs failed to evaluate and were left out: {{children}}
kpiScorecard.rowSecurityRestrictedToolti: No value is shown because row security on this model does not grant your role access to any rows. Ask an administrator for the role or persona that covers the data you need.
kpiScorecard.noKpisDesc: KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) track how well your organisation is meeting its business objectives. Each KPI compares a value measure against a goal measure and computes a status (good / warning / poor) and trend (improving / flat / declining). To create a KPI, open the KPIs panel from the Model Builder toolbelt and define a new KPI with a value measure, goal measure, and status expression.

kpis.formula.fn.share_of_total.desc: The expression's share of the overall total (0-1).

kpis.formula.fn.sum.desc: Sum the expression across the current grouping.
kpis.formula.fn.trailing_sum.desc: Sum over the last N periods.
